messages:
Jordan Blake: Quick note  all-hands tomorrow 11:00am PT. I'll give a short company update (growth targets + hiring posture) and Leila will cover a new ops playbook and runbook changes. Please drop any Qs below. Recording & slides after. :loudspeaker:
Ethan Moore: Thanks Jordan. Q: are we keeping the hiring freeze exceptions for IC-heavy roles or shifting to a quota model?
Leila Haddad: Ops Q: will the runbook change include new escalation paths to Dedicated on-call? Also I want to demo the new incident timeline view.
Dylan Price: can we get a short blurb about customer success metrics? CS asked for a one-slide summary for execs.
Marta Ruiz: Calendar-bot, confirm invite + dial-in? Also will there be a hybrid in-person option at SF office?
calendar-bot: Event created: "All-Hands Townhall" 11:00am PT. Zoom + SF conference room C reserved. Reminder set 10m before.
Jordan Blake: quick answers: hiring posture update in the meeting; hybrid in-person welcome but bring laptop — we'll stream. Ops playbook will include Dedicated on-call flow and new postmortem checklist. Keep Qs coming.
ops-bot: Note: ops will present a short 3-min demo of the incident timeline and auto-scribe feature.
Ethan Moore: follow-up Q: any guidance for M-grades for open reqs already in process?
Jordan Blake: we will publish a hiring FAQ after the townhall; decisions on current reqs are being finalized and HR will follow up with managers within 48 hours.
Leila Haddad: Agenda draft:
- 11:00 Exec update: company health & hiring posture (Jordan)
- 11:12 Customer metrics snapshot + GTM ask (Dylan)
- 11:20 Ops playbook + incident timeline demo (Leila)
- 11:30 Product & roadmap callouts (Ethan)
- 11:40 Q&A (live + collected)
Please keep questions here so we can triage.
-- (post-meeting) --
Jordan Blake: Recording & slides posted: https://redwood.slack.com/files/XYZ987654/all-hands-townhall-1867004567.mp4
Dylan Price: CS snapshot uploaded: https://docs.redwood.ai/reports/q1-cs-snapshot. Key number: NRR 112%, new logo ARR +14% this quarter.
Leila Haddad: Ops follow-ups: playbook PR merged: https://git.redwood.ai/ops/playbooks/incident-runbook. Highlights: added Dedicated on-call handoff steps, 15m golden-window for noisy-eviction mitigation, and an automated postmortem template. Full runbook in /docs/ops.
Ethan Moore: Product notes: roadmap callouts in slides — focusing on latency optimizations and two model rollout pilots. No breaking API changes this quarter.
Marta Ruiz: action for People Ops: publish hiring FAQ and decision on in-flight reqs by EOD Tue. @People Ops assigned.
Jordan Blake: Actions captured:
- People Ops: hiring FAQ + req decisions (by EOD Tue)
- Ops: add auto-scribe to incident checklist and enable Dedicated on-call path in runbook (Leila)
- Product: publish pilot details and contact list for model rollouts (Ethan)
Thanks everyone. TL;DR: modest hiring shifts with FAQ to follow, ops playbook live with Dedicated on-call flow, customer metrics healthy, and recording+slides above. Post any additional Qs here and we'll append to the FAQ. :white_check_mark:
